name: Glovis America Port Vehicle Processing - Brunswick GA

fieldNotes.siteSelection: Roster point (1 Joe Frank Harris Blvd) lands inside the Georgia Ports Authority Colonel's Island Terminal at the Port of Brunswick - confirmed via web research (GPA facilities page, glovisusa.com, Automotive Logistics). Colonel's Island is a ~1,700-acre RoRo auto terminal with multiple on-terminal vehicle processors; Glovis America operates as one of those processors. The audited facility is the GPA secured terminal as a whole, since the on-terminal processors share the gate, fence line and storage. Center placed on the terminal core at 31.1270,-81.5390.
fieldNotes.facilityType: Port / RoRo vehicle import-export processing terminal. No traditional loading docks - vehicles roll on/off ships at the RoRo berths and move within the terminal by drive-away and by rail. dockDoorCount=0 / dockDoors=NONE reflect this.
fieldNotes.railServed: Confirmed - a curved auto-rack rail loop runs into the terminal on the west side (probe rail.png), used for rail receiving/shipping of finished vehicles.
fieldNotes.truckGate: TRUE. The terminal is a fully secured GPA port facility (TWIC-controlled). All vehicular traffic funnels across a single 4-lane divided causeway and through a controlled main gate complex before reaching the storage and processing areas.
fieldNotes.guardShack: TRUE (medium confidence). A secured GPA port terminal of this class operates a staffed main gate complex; small gate-area structures are visible. Exact booth identification flagged uncertain.
fieldNotes.backupSensitive: TRUE - the entire terminal is served by ONE causeway access road; any queue at the gate would back up along the single causeway with no alternate route. High chokepoint sensitivity.
fieldNotes.multiStep: TRUE (best estimate, flagged uncertain) - secured port terminals typically run a multi-stage check (port gate, then processor/yard checkpoints). Marked truck-staging grids are visible inside the terminal.
fieldNotes.dropArea: 50+ - GPA states 637+ acres of paved open vehicle storage; tens of thousands of finished vehicles in marked rows fill the terminal.
fieldNotes.multipleFacilities: True - multiple processing buildings and several on-terminal processors plus RoRo berth infrastructure on a single large campus.
fieldNotes.urbanRural: Rural - the terminal sits on a marsh peninsula isolated from Brunswick's urban fabric, reached only by the causeway.
fieldNotes.siteAreaAcres: ~1627 acres from the perimeter box, consistent with the GPA-stated ~1,700-acre terminal.
